description: Kafka consumer lag monitoring dashboard showing increasing consumer lag on the routing-decisions topic. Lag grows from 0 to 12,000 messages over 10 minutes. Producer rate is stable at 200 msg/s but consumer rate dropped to 50 msg/s.
visual_elements: consumer rate chart (drop from 200 to 50 msg/s at 14:30 UTC)
demo_context: This shows what happens when the event consumer can't keep up with the workload producer — relevant to the Kafka firehose demo.
